His mother dies shortly after his release, and despite the objections of his only friend, Jacques, and his mother's neighbor Jeanne, Michel teams up with a couple of petty thieves in order to improve his craft. With a police inspector keeping an eye on him, Michel also tries to get a straight job, but the temptation to steal is hard to resist.

items.title: Crossing Over
items.tagline: Every day thousands of people illegally cross our borders... only one thing stands in their way. America.
items.overview: Immigrants from around the world enter Los Angeles every day, with hopeful visions of a better life, but little notion of what that life may cost. Their desperate scenarios test the humanity of immigration enforcement officers. In Crossing Over, writer-director Wayne Kramer explores the allure of the American dream, and the reality that immigrants find – and create -- in 21st century L.A.

items.title: Door Lock
items.tagline: In my house a stranger is waiting.
items.overview: Kyung-min lives alone in a one-room apartment. One day, she finds traces of a stranger breaking into her room and soon a mysterious murder case begins to unravel.

items.title: The American Society of Magical Negroes
items.tagline: Saving the damn world.
items.overview: A young man, Aren, is recruited into a secret society of magical Black people who dedicate their lives to a cause of utmost importance: making white people’s lives easier.

items.title: Xeno
items.tagline: One bond. Two worlds.
items.overview: A teenage girl develops an otherworldly bond with an alien after it crash-lands in the desert. As government agents close in, she must protect her new friend, while uncovering a secret that could change the fate of both their worlds.

items.title: Black Eagle
items.tagline: There are no armies. There is no glory. This fight is one on one.
items.overview: One of the US Air Force's most modern tactical aircrafts, an F-100 with a new laser guidance system, crashes into the sea near Malta - a region where the Soviet forces are highly present, too. The CIA immediately sends out their best secret agent, Ken Tani, to salvage the system before it falls into enemy hands. To ensure his loyalty, they bring his two young sons to a nearby hotel on the island.

items.title: Limelight
items.tagline: The masterpiece of laughter and tears from the master of comedy!
items.overview: A fading music hall comedian tries to help a despondent ballet dancer learn to walk and to again feel confident about life.

items.title: Battle at Big Rock
items.tagline: Do not feed wildlife.
items.overview: A family's camping trip at Big Rock National Park becomes a terrifying fight for survival.

items.title: The Dude in Me
items.tagline: A body swap that changed everything.
items.overview: Dong-hyun is a high school student. One day, he falls from the rooftop and bumps into Pan-soo who is a passerby. Pan-soo is a member of a criminal organization. When the two men wake up in the hospital, they discover that they have switched bodies.

items.title: Justin and the Knights of Valour
items.overview: A heart-warming tale about friendship, honor & courage, which sees a young boy become a man as he embarks on a quest to become a knight.

items.title: Irresistible
items.tagline: Send in the clowns.
items.overview: A Democratic political consultant helps a retired Marine colonel run for mayor in a small, conservative Wisconsin town.

items.title: Capone
items.tagline: We all pay for our crimes in the end.
items.overview: The 47-year old Al Capone, after 10 years in prison, starts suffering from dementia and comes to be haunted by his violent past.

items.title: Blue Spring
items.tagline: AREN’T THERE SOME FLOWERS THAT NEVER BLOOM.
items.overview: Soon after being named the new leader of his high school's gang system, Kujo grows bored with the violence and hatred that surround him. He wants desperately to abandon his post… but his once-enviable position of power has a strange way of making him feel powerless.

items.title: Mafia Mamma
items.tagline: From suburban Mom to mafia Don.
items.overview: A suburban American woman inherits her grandfather’s Mafia empire and, guided by the Firm’s trusted consigliere, defies everyone’s expectations, including her own, as the new head of the family business.

items.title: Kill Your Darlings
items.tagline: A true story of obsession and murder.
items.overview: A murder in 1944 draws together the great poets of the beat generation: Allen Ginsberg, Jack Kerouac and William Burroughs.

items.title: Madea's Destination Wedding
items.tagline: They trippin'.
items.overview: Madea packs her best floral dresses and a whole lot of chaos when the Simmons family heads to the Bahamas for her grandniece's whirlwind wedding.

items.title: Aces Go Places II
items.overview: An assassin called Filthy Harry is hired by a shady figure and charged with killing the heroes.  The men are framed twice for different robberies by King Kong's new girlfriend, nearly committed to a mental hospital by their devious boss, and forced to battle Filthy Harry's weaponry-laden robot while covered with time bombs.

items.title: The Hunter's Prayer
items.tagline: It's just business
items.overview: An assassin forges an unlikely partnership with one of his targets: a woman seeking revenge for the murder of her family.

items.title: Love, Weddings & Other Disasters
items.tagline: A match made in madness.
items.overview: A fussy celebrity caterer, a blind woman, a tour-bus guide and an inexperienced wedding planner search for love.

items.title: Marvel Studios Assembled: The Making of Thor: Love and Thunder
items.overview: Settle in with the likes of Taika Waititi, Chris Hemsworth, Natalie Portman, Christian Bale, and Tessa Thompson, and as they divulge the secrets behind the creation of Thor: Love and Thunder. Through in-depth interviews with cast and crew, along with raw, unseen footage from the set and beyond, this documentary special pulls back the curtain on the God of Thunder’s fourth feature film.

items.title: Lost Boys: The Tribe
items.tagline: Never grow old. Never die. Never know fear again.
items.overview: Surfing vampires hit the waves, rule the night and seek fresh blood, and the new girl in town may be exactly what they're craving.

items.title: Dhoom 3
items.tagline: This year will end with a Dhoom.
items.overview: To avenge his father's death, a circus entertainer trained in magic and acrobatics robs banks to take down a corrupt bank owner. Two cops from Mumbai are assigned to the case.

items.title: Avengers Grimm
items.tagline: A battle of legendary proportions.
items.overview: When Rumpelstiltskin destroys the Magic Mirror and escapes to the modern world, the four princesses of "Once Upon a Time"-Cinderella, Sleeping Beauty, Snow White, and Rapunzel-are sucked through the portal too. Well-trained and endowed with magical powers, the four women must fight Rumpelstiltskin and his army of thralls before he enslaves everyone on Earth.

items.title: Wingwomen
items.overview: Tired of life on the run, a pro thief decides to retire — but not before one easy last job with her partner in crime and a feisty new getaway driver.

items.title: Stakeout
items.tagline: It's a tough job but somebody's got to do it!
items.overview: Two detectives observe an escaped convict's ex-girlfriend, but complications set in when one of them falls for her.

items.title: The Private Life of Sherlock Holmes
items.tagline: Anything But Elementary.
items.overview: When a bored Sherlock eagerly takes the case of Gabrielle Valladon following an attempt on her life, the search for her missing husband leads to Loch Ness and the legendary monster.

items.title: Drop Dead Fred
items.tagline: Dishes. Relationships. Wind. This Guy Breaks Everything.
items.overview: An unhappy housewife gets a lift from the return of her imaginary childhood friend, Drop Dead Fred.

items.title: Dogs Don't Wear Pants
items.tagline: You take my breath away.
items.overview: A grieving heart surgeon struggling with the loss of his wife drifts through an emotionally detached life while raising his teenage daughter. His chance encounter with a dominatrix awakens feelings he thought were gone, drawing him into a dark and unconventional world where pain and desire intertwine.

items.title: Horizon Line
items.tagline: Fly or die.
items.overview: A couple flying on a small plane to attend a tropical island wedding must fight for their lives after their pilot suffers a heart attack.

items.title: X+Y
items.tagline: Is there a formula for love?
items.overview: Struggling to connect with those around him, a teenage math prodigy trains for the International Mathematical Olympiad, where a budding romance with a fellow contestant breaks through his emotional walls and teaches him that love cannot be calculated.

items.title: Man Up
items.tagline: If you can't get a date... just steal one!
items.overview: A 34 year old single woman, Nancy, hung-over again, exhausted by the endless fruitless set ups by her friends, traveling across London to toast another 10 years of her parents' successful happy magical marriage runs in with a 40 year old divorcee, Jack, who mistakes her for his 24 year old blind date. Nancy, deciding to go with it, happens to hop on the most chaotic yet hilarious journey of her life which neither of them will ever forget.

items.title: Assassination Nation
items.tagline: You asked for it, America.
items.overview: After an anonymous hacker begins leaking the private data of thousands living in a small American town, the townspeople spiral into madness, with four high school seniors at the center of the maelstrom.

items.title: Ernest & Celestine
items.tagline: Bonnie and Clyde, Sid and Nancy...
items.overview: Celestine is a little mouse trying to avoid a dental career while Ernest is a big bear craving an artistic outlet. When Celestine meets Ernest, they overcome their natural enmity by forging a life of crime together.

items.title: Confidential Assignment
items.tagline: Joint mission, hidden intentions.
items.overview: When a crime organization from North Korea crosses borders and enters South Korean soil, a South Korean detective must cooperate with a North Korean detective to investigate their whereabouts.

items.title: Dr. Mabuse, the Gambler
items.overview: Dr. Mabuse and his organization of criminals are in the process of completing their latest scheme, a theft of information that will allow Mabuse to make huge profits on the stock exchange. Afterwards, Mabuse disguises himself and attends the Folies Bergères show, where Cara Carozza, the main attraction of the show, passes him information on Mabuse's next intended victim, the young millionaire Edgar Hull. Mabuse then uses psychic manipulation to lure Hull into a card game where he loses heavily. When Police Commissioner von Wenk begins an investigation of this mysterious crime spree, he has little to go on, and he needs to find someone who can help him.

items.title: Ginger Snaps Back: The Beginning
items.tagline: Evil Rises.
items.overview: Set in 19th Century Canada, Brigitte and her sister Ginger take refuge in a Traders' Fort which later becomes under siege by some savage werewolves. But when one of the girls is bitten, they have no one to turn to but themselves.

items.title: The Cheetah Girls
items.tagline: They have one shot to show their spots.
items.overview: A four-member teen girl group named the Cheetah Girls go to a Manhattan High School for the Performing Arts and try to become the first freshmen to win the talent show in the school's history. During the talent show auditions, they meet a big-time producer named Jackal Johnson, who tries to make the group into superstars, but the girls run into many problems.

items.title: Lupin the Third vs. Detective Conan
items.tagline: Is yet another case closed or will there be a deadly cliffhanger?
items.overview: When a wealthy woman and her son die in a hunting accident, it's up to Conan Edogawa to solve the case. Meanwhile, Lupin the Third is after the Queen Crown, owned by the Vesparand royal family. When these two legendary characters meet, who will win the day?! Followed by “Lupin the Third vs. Detective Conan: The Movie” (2013).
items.collection: Lupin the Third vs Detective Conan Collection

items.title: Sitting in Bars with Cake
items.tagline: There’s no recipe for the perfect friendship.
items.overview: Extrovert Corinne convinces Jane, a shy, talented baker, to commit to a year of bringing cakes to bars, to help her meet people and build confidence. But when Corinne receives a life-altering diagnosis, the pair faces a challenge unlike anything they've experienced before.

items.title: Code Name: The Cleaner
items.tagline: In a dirty world, he's our only hope.
items.overview: Cedric the Entertainer plays Jake, a seemingly regular guy who has no idea who he is after being hit over the head by mysterious assailants. When he finds himself entangled in a government conspiracy, Jake and his pursuers become convinced that he is an undercover agent.

items.title: A Summer's Tale
items.overview: Awaiting his girlfriend Léna’s arrival at the Breton seaside resort of Dinard, Gaspard befriends — and flirts heavily with — two other women, the companionable ethnology student Margot and the sensual townie Solène, making for a rather complicated situation when Léna finally arrives.

items.title: Paranoia
items.tagline: In a war between kings even a pawn can change the game.
items.overview: An entry-level employee at a powerful corporation finds himself occupying a corner office, but at a dangerous price—he must spy on his boss's old mentor to secure for him a multi-billion dollar advantage.
